title: Ghost holding a heart
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Ghost body -->
  <path d="M30 40 Q30 15 50 15 Q70 15 70 40 L70 78 Q65 72 60 78 Q55 84 50 78 Q45 72 40 78 Q35 84 30 78 Z" fill="#c8e6ff" stroke="none"/>
  <!-- Ghost body shading -->
  <path d="M30 40 Q30 15 50 15 Q70 15 70 40 L70 78 Q65 72 60 78 Q55 84 50 78 Q45 72 40 78 Q35 84 30 78 Z" fill="#e8f4ff" opacity="0.4"/>
  <!-- Ghost darker edge on right -->
  <path d="M60 20 Q70 20 70 40 L70 78 Q65 72 60 78 Z" fill="#a8d4f0" opacity="0.5"/>
  <!-- Eyes -->
  <ellipse cx="42" cy="38" rx="5" ry="6" fill="#1a2a3a"/>
  <ellipse cx="58" cy="38" rx="5" ry="6" fill="#1a2a3a"/>
  <!-- Eye highlights -->
  <ellipse cx="43.5" cy="36" rx="2" ry="2.2" fill="#ffffff" opacity="0.9"/>
  <ellipse cx="59.5" cy="36" rx="2" ry="2.2" fill="#ffffff" opacity="0.9"/>
  <!-- Cute mouth -->
  <path d="M46 50 Q50 55 54 50" fill="none" stroke="#1a2a3a" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- Cheeks -->
  <ellipse cx="36" cy="48" rx="4" ry="3" fill="#ffb8cc" opacity="0.7"/>
  <ellipse cx="64" cy="48" rx="4" ry="3" fill="#ffb8cc" opacity="0.7"/>
  <!-- Heart in ghost's hands area -->
  <path d="M50 68 Q50 62 44 62 Q38 62 38 68 Q38 74 50 82 Q62 74 62 68 Q62 62 56 62 Q50 62 50 68 Z" fill="#ff3b5c"/>
  <!-- Heart highlight -->
  <path d="M43 66 Q45 63 48 63" fill="none" stroke="#ff9ab0" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- Ghost hands holding heart -->
  <ellipse cx="36" cy="68" rx="6" ry="4" fill="#d8eeff"/>
  <ellipse cx="64" cy="68" rx="6" ry="4" fill="#c8e6ff"/>
  <!-- Small sparkles -->
  <path d="M22 28 L24 30 L22 32 L20 30 Z" fill="#ffe680" opacity="0.8"/>
  <path d="M78 30 L80 32 L78 34 L76 32 Z" fill="#ffe680" opacity="0.8"/>
  <circle cx="20" cy="50" r="1.5" fill="#ffe680" opacity="0.7"/>
  <circle cx="80" cy="48" r="1.5" fill="#ffe680" opacity="0.7"/>
</svg>
